death.note: The year 'three' refers to 803 AH, inferred from the context of Timur's fitna (803 AH).

relation.note: Taken captive by Timur (al-Lank, wd:Q8462) during his invasion and brought to his lands.

event.desc: The whole notice is drawn from Ibn Ḥajar (shaykhunā) in his Inbāʾ al-Ghumr.

event.note: Taken by Timur to his lands during the fitna of Timur (803 AH).
Arrived after his release from Timur's captivity, in the year of his death.

person.note: 我らがシャイフ（イブン・ハジャル）は『インバー』において彼について、まず毛皮商の仕事をしていたが、その後しばらく勤め、スルタンの庁舎で働き、それからワズィール職に就いたと述べた。彼がワズィールであった時にティムールの騒乱（803年）が起こり、彼はティムールに伴われて彼の故郷へ連行されたが、間もなく解放され、ダマスクスに帰還した。そこでシャアバーン月に軍事監督職などに就任した。そして803年に亡くなった。

Our shaykh (Ibn Ḥajar) said in his 『Inbāʾ』 that he first engaged in the furrier's craft, then worked for a short time and served in the Sultan's chancellery, and then became a vizier. When the fitna of Timur (803 AH) occurred, he was a vizier, and Timur took him with him to his lands. He was released after a short period, then arrived in Damascus, where he undertook the supervision of the army and other duties in Shaʿbān. He died in the year 803 AH.
